questions.question: What is the minimum notice period for non-payment evictions in Minnesota?
questions.explanation: Minnesota law requires a 14-day notice for non-payment of rent cases (MN Stat § 504B.135)

questions.question: Can a landlord lock you out without a court order?
questions.explanation: Self-help evictions (lockouts) are illegal in Minnesota. Landlords must go through the court process.

questions.question: How long do you have to respond to an eviction summons?
options: Within the time stated on the summons
questions.explanation: The summons will specify your answer deadline - usually 7-14 days. Always check your specific summons!
